name: review-changes-nothing
description: Review mode on a pasted ticket fills the report template, finds the single sub-issue and the untagged criterion, and writes nothing.
prompt:
/plan-work review This ticket, pasted because there is no tracker tool:

ABC-7 Store owners export orders as CSV
## What
Export orders.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] It works.

It has one sub-issue, ABC-8 feat(export): add the endpoint, repo `api`, with criteria '- [ ] #1 [unit] One row per order.'
Do not run any tool except the bundled lint.
